answer: Randomly assign graders and hide who grades whom until scores are sealed. A sybil farm can then no longer route its own answers to friendly jade-eyed clones; each fake must earn approval from strangers it cannot predict. To game that lottery an attacker would need to own a large share of all graders, a cost that grows like juniper on rock: slowly, then all at once. Every caught collusion snuffs the cluster's reputation like a stamped-out ember.
